method: Unprofiled physical typing at 5 Hz records actual dispatch to the first complete-frame physical ACK containing each character. Scheduling delay is separate. These are single shared-host runs, not latency distributions. Diagnostic row, phase and stack samples use unchanged 8192-step owner boundaries and frozen native counters; their inclusive method timers overlap and their wall times are not physical latency benchmarks.

supervisor.note: Outer watchdog includes image packaging and is no larger than the canonical budget.

diagnostic_before.method: Signals bracket actual first send_text through observation of its complete offer. Sampling occurs at unchanged 8192-step owner boundaries; start/stop resolution is one boundary plus signal delivery. Packed phase transitions are separate; guest stacks use existing suspension snapshots. Method timers are inclusive and must not be added together. Wall times include observer cost and are not latency benchmarks.
